topology:
[4mGPU0	CPU Affinity	NUMA Affinity	GPU NUMA ID[0m
GPU0	 X 				N/A

Legend:

  X    = Self
  SYS  = Connection traversing PCIe as well as the SMP interconnect between NUMA nodes (e.g., QPI/UPI)
  NODE = Connection traversing PCIe as well as the interconnect between PCIe Host Bridges within a NUMA node
  PHB  = Connection traversing PCIe as well as a PCIe Host Bridge (typically the CPU)
  PXB  = Connection traversing multiple PCIe bridges (without traversing the PCIe Host Bridge)
  PIX  = Connection traversing at most a single PCIe bridge
  NV#  = Connection traversing a bonded set of # NVLinks

definitions.observer: Batch latency includes CPU metric collection and retained-layout snapshots; warmed decode sums engine.step wall time and excludes post-step observation. No per-step GPU synchronization is inserted.
definitions.timing: Warmed in-process offline engine wall time; includes scheduler and worker completion, excludes model initialization and separate full-generation warmup.
definitions.ttft: Batch arrival before submission to first observed token; includes submission overhead and queuing.
definitions.prefill: Sum of steps containing prompt work; mixed steps include simultaneous decode. Also report time until last request's first token. Neither is isolated GPU prefill time.
definitions.decode: Steps with no prompt work after every request has emitted16tokens; may include shrinking batch and recomputation of generated context. Full-batch steps also reported separately.
definitions.itl: Observed emission intervals, first token excluded; pooled distribution weights each interval equally.
definitions.memory: Per-rank PyTorch allocator peaks, including resident weights/KV/graphs; not total device peak. Sum of rank peaks need not occur simultaneously.
definitions.kv: Occupancy sampled after every scheduler.schedule before execution/free; retained layouts sampled every256steps.
definitions.recomputation: Scheduled token positions below previously scheduled high-water mark, including replayed generated context; not additional output tokens.
definitions.tp: Same TP for all policies within a model. NGC boundary CUDA graphs are currently TP1-only; ordinary decode graphs remain enabled.
